object: a squad of interlocking bricks and little bricks shaped like trees
morph: two brick trees peek and hide before they become 林
creativeAngle: 積木小隊玩躲貓貓，兩棵木頭樹拼出林，詞用「樹林」。
promptEn: An 8-second animated clip teaching the Traditional Chinese character 林 (woods). Lead: a team of blue and yellow bricks. Moment 1 (0-1.7s): a green brick tree peeks from the left; the voice says 林; the team turns, the tree vanishes. Moment 2 (1.7-3.4s): a second tree pops from the right, dodging; bricks chase and bump; on the second 林 both trees slide together as 林. Moment 3 (3.4-5.3s): the bricks hide behind the trees but their legs show; as the voice says 樹林 more tiny brick trees pop up around, hiding the whole team like a forest. Moment 4 (5.3-8s): glyph still; one brick pops its head out and waves, then ducks again. Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice in clear Taiwanese Mandarin reads exactly "林、林、樹林" (ㄌㄧㄣˊ、ㄌㄧㄣˊ、ㄕㄨˋ ㄌㄧㄣˊ), slowly and distinctly with clear tones, then stops; no other speech, no music louder than the voice. The only on-screen text is the single Traditional Chinese glyph 林, drawn as saturated solid forest green strokes on a pale peach background, correctly formed, centered, filling about 70% of frame height with margins, perfectly still for the final 3-second hold while the lead keeps a small joyful motion away from the strokes. No vocabulary text, subtitles, watermark, clutter, flashing, real people or realistic humans; bright but not neon, no dark grading.
